title: Simulator accepts out-of-range explicit TDMA beacon assignments
description: Post-fix correctness review of python/src/lichen/sim/tdma.py found TDMAScheduler.sync_from_beacon accepts any assigned value >=0 without exact type or assigned<num_slots validation, then marks the node SYNCED. A malformed or impossible slot assignment can therefore place the simulated node outside the advertised superframe instead of rejecting the beacon. Validate exact u32 SFN, non-negative exact receive time, positive exact num_slots, and assigned=-1 or 0..num_slots-1 before mutating scheduler state; add failure-atomic boundary tests.
